- TOTAL revenue reached £16,740.23 TW versus £5,757.32 LW, a WoW change of +190.8%.
- TOTAL units came in at 15,031 TW against 2,024 LW, a WoW change of +642.6%, while TOTAL orders were 166 TW, +23.0% WoW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER ranked 1 TW with £3,388.78, a 20.2% share of TW revenue, and led on orders with 62 TW.
- WOODEN SKITTLES GARDEN SET posted £2,650.90 TW for a 15.8% share, and PACK OF 12 SUKI TISSUES posted £2,573.71 TW for a 15.4% share.
- The top 3 products together accounted for 51.5% of TOTAL revenue TW.
- PACK OF 12 SUKI TISSUES recorded the largest absolute WoW revenue gain, moving from £42.63 LW to £2,573.71 TW, and topped units at 5,247 TW.
- PACK OF 12 HEARTS DESIGN TISSUES showed the largest percentage WoW revenue gain at +6,087.6%.
- PARTY BUNTING recorded the largest WoW revenue decline at 12.4%, and PACK OF 12 PINK SPOT TISSUES was the lowest ranked product with £1,279.52 TW and a 7.6% share.
